episodes.title: Vamos a ser muy grandes
episodes.summary: Olimpia starts selling drugs when she learns that her husband is sick and she needs to help her family.

episodes.title: No es cosa de mujeres
episodes.summary: Olimpia meets a drug dealer who offers her a trip to Colombia to bring cocaine.

episodes.title: Por mis muertos
episodes.summary: Between Spain and Colombia, Olimpia and her men have trouble getting the merchandise.

episodes.title: Lo que no tiene arreglo es una mentira
episodes.summary: Olimpia manages to smuggle the merchandise, but her family knows her secret and tries to stop her.

episodes.title: Vas a ser muy grande
episodes.summary: Olimpia and "El Moreno" expand their business and close a deal to ship their merchandise to Italy.

episodes.title: Si tienes un problema...
episodes.summary: Exiled by her family, with her husband ill and many enemies, Olimpia will continue with her goal.
